oci_general_017.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-8452: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service. . Product: NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
